answer: PoA limits Sybil identities by requiring each candidate to complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings before its Wesolowski proof is accepted. Because each step depends on the previous result, GPUs cannot parallelize a single chain to finish it sooner; clones still need separate work and resources. This creates a measurable time and hardware cost, not an absolute ban. An atlas of proofs can be checked cheaply by every vault and summit node.
